user_story: As a user, I want to create a task with only a title and no optional fields so that minimal input is sufficient.

positive.title: Create task with valid title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a valid title in the title field
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the provided title

positive.title: Create task with minimal title length
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a title with minimum allowed characters
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the minimal title

negative.title: Create task with empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating title is required

negative.title: Create task with title exceeding character limit
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a title that exceeds the maximum character limit
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating title exceeds limit

edge.title: Create task with title having special characters
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a title that includes special characters (e.g. @, #, $, etc.)
edge.expected_result: Task is created successfully with a title containing special characters

edge.title: Create task with maximum allowed title length
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a title with the maximum allowed characters
edge.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the title at maximum length
